$comment: Which projects appear under 'Selected work'. With source 'pinned' the cards follow the repos pinned on github.com/levmetal (same order, max 6): change your pins and the profile updates on the next workflow run. Use source 'manual' plus 'repos' to pick them here instead. 'overrides' polishes the copy for a repo; anything missing falls back to the repo's own description, topics, languages and homepage.

BLAME.description: systemd-analyze blame, for Windows. Reads the boot diagnostics log Windows already keeps and shows which apps, drivers and services slowed your last startup.

LolNexus.title: LoL Nexus
LolNexus.description: Companion app for League of Legends: champion data, real-time item scaling and ability-damage maths, with a Playwright QA suite guarding the game logic.

PLAYERSOUND.title: PlayerSound
PLAYERSOUND.description: Search and stream audio from YouTube with no login. Two playback engines (local stream or official iframe) and playlists persisted locally in IndexedDB.

ABC-autosalvage-web.title: ABC Auto Salvage
ABC-autosalvage-web.description: Production site for an auto-salvage business. Astro islands with React, GSAP-driven motion and Lenis smooth scrolling, styled with Tailwind CSS v4.

Rodriguez-yard.title: Rodriguez Yard
Rodriguez-yard.description: Fully responsive landing for a North Carolina salvage yard, with a serverless “get an offer” flow that turns visitors into qualified leads.

personal-books-skills.title: Personal Books Skills
personal-books-skills.description: A Claude Code plugin marketplace of agent skills distilled from books on design, UX and AI — Don Norman, Designing AI Interfaces and more.

Visa-system-landing-page.title: Visa System
Visa-system-landing-page.description: Landing page for a US visa application service: clear service tiers, modal-driven contact flow and optimised images for a fast first load.
